sentences.en: Today, he was the rare foreign executive to reach rock star status in Japan by breaking the rules of its culture.
sentences.zh: 今天的故事是，他通过打破日本文化规则，成为了罕见在日本达到摇滚巨星地位的外国高管。

sentences.en: Then he went too far.
sentences.zh: 然后他走得太远了。

sentences.en: The rise and fall of Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩的起伏人生。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, April 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月16日，星期二。

sentences.en: So on April 9th, this mysterious video appeared.
sentences.zh: 所以在4月9日，这段神秘的视频出现了。

sentences.en: Carlos Ghosn, the longtime chief executive and chairman of Nissan, which is a Japanese auto company, is sitting in this room.
sentences.zh: 日本汽车公司日产的长期首席执行官兼董事长卡洛斯·戈恩正坐在这样一个房间里。

sentences.en: It's almost like a hostage video.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是一个人质视频。

sentences.en: He's sitting at this table in a very bare conference room.
sentences.zh: 他坐在一个非常简陋的会议室的桌子旁。

sentences.en: He's got a black suit jacket on and a white button down, but no tie.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件黑色西装外套和一件白色衬衫，但没有系领带。

sentences.en: And he's looking basically straight on into the camera.
sentences.zh: 他的目光基本上直视着摄像机。

sentences.en: And the first thing he says is, if you are listening to me through this video today, it means that I was not able to make the press conference that I planned for April the 11th.
sentences.zh: 他说的第一句话是，如果你今天通过这段视频听到我的声音，那就意味着我无法出席我原定于4月11日举行的记者会。

sentences.en: He can't be there because he's in jail.
sentences.zh: 他不能去，因为他在监狱里。

sentences.en: He had called a press conference on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上宣布要召开记者会。

sentences.en: He was planning to explain previous charges.
sentences.zh: 他原本计划解释先前的指控。

sentences.en: So he'd been arrested before and he wanted to come out in public and explain why he was innocent of those charges.
sentences.zh: 所以他之前被捕过，他希望公开露面，解释为什么自己对这些指控是无辜的。

sentences.en: But before he could do that, he was arrested again.
sentences.zh: 但在他这样做之前，他又被捕了。

sentences.en: Motoko Rich is the Tokyo bureau chief for The Times.
sentences.zh: 莫托科·里奇是《纽约时报》东京分社社长。

sentences.en: So what exactly is going on here?
sentences.zh: 这里到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Why is the head of Nissan being repeatedly arrested?
sentences.zh: 为什么日产的掌门人会屡次被捕？

sentences.en: Well, this is kind of a big epic drama.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这可以说是部宏大的史诗级大剧。

sentences.en: All the accusation that came around these charges.
sentences.zh: 所有围绕这些指控的指责。

sentences.en: About culture clash on a grand scale.
sentences.zh: 关于大规模的文化冲突。

sentences.en: That are all biased.
sentences.zh: 这些都是有偏见的。

sentences.en: This is a story about money and greed.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于金钱和贪婪的故事。

sentences.en: Twisted in a way to paint a personnage of greed.
sentences.zh: 它被扭曲成了一幅贪婪人物的画像。

sentences.en: And the crown jewel of Japan's economy, the auto industry.
sentences.zh: 而日本经济的皇冠上的明珠，即汽车产业。

sentences.en: And the personnage of dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 以及独裁统治的形象。

sentences.en: This is a story about a criminal justice system that, despite being part of a major democracy, seems to have violations of civil rights.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于刑事司法系统的故事，尽管它属于一个主要的民主国家，却似乎存在侵犯公民权利的行为。

sentences.en: I'm innocent of all the charges that have been brought against me.
sentences.zh: 我对加在我身上的所有指控都是清白的。

sentences.en: And above all, it's about the particularities of this one unique business executive, Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，这是关于这位独特的商业高管卡洛斯·戈恩的独特性格。

sentences.en: So tell us, who is Carlos Ghosn?
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我们，卡洛斯·戈恩是谁？

sentences.en: So Carlos Ghosn is this international figure.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩是一个国际人物。

sentences.en: He was born in Brazil to Lebanese immigrants and he moved to Beirut as a toddler.
sentences.zh: 他出生于巴西的黎巴嫩移民家庭，在幼儿时期搬到了贝鲁特。

sentences.en: And then he went to some elite schools in Paris, studied engineering at elite university.
sentences.zh: 然后他在巴黎的一些精英学校上学，并在精英大学学习工程学。

sentences.en: And then he was hired by Michelin, the tire company.
sentences.zh: 接着他被轮胎公司米其林聘用。

sentences.en: And he was working his way up there.
sentences.zh: 他在那里一步步往上爬。

sentences.en: He worked there for 18 years.
sentences.zh: 他在那里工作了18年。

sentences.en: He started on the factory floor, but he was very quickly, his talent was spotted and he rose through the ranks.
sentences.zh: 他从工厂车间干起，但他的才华很快被发现，并一路晋升。

sentences.en: And then they gave him the job of being CEO of
sentences.zh: 然后他们给了他一个职位，担任

sentences.en: Michelin's North American division.
sentences.zh: 米其林北美分公司的首席执行官。

sentences.en: At Michelin, he realized it was a family company and he really wanted to keep going up.
sentences.zh: 在米其林，他意识到这是一家家族企业，他真的很想继续往上爬。

sentences.en: And he thought, I'm never going to get that far in this company.
sentences.zh: 他心想，我在这家公司永远走不了那么远。

sentences.en: I'm not going to get to the top in any case.
sentences.zh: 无论如何我都不会爬到顶层。

sentences.en: So he took a job at Renault, which is a French company.
sentences.zh: 于是他接受了雷诺的一份工作，这是一家法国公司。

sentences.en: And Renault, at that point, was reeling from a disastrous merger with Volvo.
sentences.zh: 当时的雷诺正从与沃尔沃灾难性的合并中艰难恢复。

sentences.en: And so he kind of came in.
sentences.zh: 所以他算是空降进来的。

sentences.en: And what his approach was, was he slashed costs and he kind of earned this name, Le Coste Cotterre.
sentences.zh: 他的方法是大肆削减成本，并因此赢得了“成本杀手”的美誉。

sentences.en: L'alliance est désormais scellée entre les constructeurs français et japonais, Renault et Nissan.
sentences.zh: 法国与日本汽车制造商雷诺和日产之间的联盟现已正式缔结。

sentences.en: And Renault itself bought a very large stake in Nissan, a Japanese company that was on the verge of going into bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 雷诺本身收购了日产的大量股份，这家日本公司当时正处于破产的边缘。

sentences.en: They had sort of car models that nobody really wanted to buy and they were lagging behind Toyota and Honda.
sentences.zh: 他们的车型没有什么人想买，并且落后于丰田和本田。

sentences.en: And since Carlos Ghosn had been so successful at helping to turn around Renault, they thought he might want to try his hand at doing the same at Nissan.
sentences.zh: 由于卡洛斯·戈恩在协助拯救雷诺方面取得了巨大成功，他们认为他可能会想在日产尝试做同样的事。

sentences.en: So they sent him to Japan as chief operating officer in 1999.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在1999年派他去日本担任首席运营官。

sentences.en: So basically, this is a major turnaround operation.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是一次重大的扭转乾坤的行动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And in fact, Bob Lutz, who was then vice chairman of General Motors, famously said that
sentences.zh: 事实上，时任通用汽车副董事长的鲍勃·卢茨曾有一句名言：

sentences.en: Renault would be better off taking five billion dollars, putting it on a barge and sinking it in the middle of the ocean.
sentences.zh: 雷诺最好拿出五十亿美元，把它放在驳船上，然后沉入大洋深处。

sentences.en: That's how bad things were.
sentences.zh: 情况就是这么糟糕。

sentences.en: This is the company that Ghosn has sent in to rescue.
sentences.zh: 这就是戈恩被派去拯救的公司。

sentences.en: And how big a deal is it for a Japanese car company to turn to a non-Japanese leader?
sentences.zh: 一家日本汽车公司转向一个非日本籍的领导者，这有多大分量？

sentences.en: It's a huge deal.
sentences.zh: 分量极重。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty unusual for a Japanese company of any stripe to hire a foreigner to run the company.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，任何类型的日本公司聘请外国人来管理公司都是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: And in particular, Nissan was an auto company.
sentences.zh: 尤其是日产还是一家汽车公司。

sentences.en: And the auto industry is the crown jewel of the Japanese economy.
sentences.zh: 而汽车产业是日本经济皇冠上的明珠。

sentences.en: Back in the 80s, when everybody was worried that Japan was going to take over the world, it was the auto industry that was concerning people the moSt. And so the fact that
sentences.zh: 早在80年代，当每个人都担心日本将接管世界时，正是汽车产业最让人担忧。所以事实上，

sentences.en: this company was on the brink of bankruptcy and that the only way out they could see was to sell a
sentences.zh: 这家公司濒临破产，他们能想到的唯一出路就是把

sentences.en: large stake to a foreign company and then to have a foreign executive come in and basically take over leadership is a sign of desperation, but also highly unusual.
sentences.zh: 大笔股份卖给一家外国公司，然后让一位外国高管进来并基本上接管领导权，这既是一个绝望的信号，也极其不寻常。

sentences.en: So given that, what do the Japanese make of this new head of Nissan, Carlos Ghosn?
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，日本人对日产这位新掌门人卡洛斯·戈恩有什么看法？

sentences.en: So I think there probably were a handful of people, certainly at Nissan and probably within
sentences.zh: 我想可能有一小部分人，当然在日产内部，可能也在

sentences.en: government circles and elite business circles who kind of cast a wary eye at him and thought, who is this guy?
sentences.zh: 政府圈子和精英商业圈子里，对他投以警惕的目光，心想，这家伙是谁？

sentences.en: Who's this foreigner?
sentences.zh: 这个外国人是谁？

sentences.en: We're not sure we want him here.
sentences.zh: 我们不确定是否想让他来这里。

sentences.en: But he also brought in a breath of fresh air.
sentences.zh: 但他也带来了清新的气息。

sentences.en: He was different.
sentences.zh: 他是与众不同的。

sentences.en: He wore pinstripe suits and walked around with these rectangular sunglasses.
sentences.zh: 他穿着细条纹西装，戴着这种矩形太阳镜到处走。

sentences.en: And I think people started to glom on to the fact that, you know, he was a completely different leader than they were used to.
sentences.zh: 我想人们开始意识到，你知道，他是一个与他们习惯的完全不同的领导者。

sentences.en: And how did he actually do at the job?
sentences.zh: 他实际干得怎么样？

sentences.en: So he came in and he did some really difficult things.
sentences.zh: 他一上任就做了一些非常艰难的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, he had his reputation of being
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他有着

sentences.en: Le Coste Coteur and he did it again at Nissan.
sentences.zh: 成本杀手的名声，他在日产又如法炮制了一次。

sentences.en: So he looked at the structure of the company, which was very similar to a lot of Japanese companies where they'd been offering a lifetime employment.
sentences.zh: 所以他审视了公司的结构，这与许多日本公司非常相似，他们一直提供终身雇佣制。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, this is a bloated workforce.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，这是一个臃肿的劳动力队伍。

sentences.en: And he slashed it by
sentences.zh: 他将其裁员了

sentences.en: 14 percent.
sentences.zh: 14个百分点。

sentences.en: So like 21,000 people lost their jobs under Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 所以在卡洛斯·戈恩的领导下，大约有2.1万人失去了工作。

sentences.en: But he also improved the product lines.
sentences.zh: 但他也改善了产品线。

sentences.en: The Nissan Maxima proves that beauty can be more than skin deep.
sentences.zh: 日产Maxima证明了美不仅仅流于表面。

sentences.en: And under his leadership, he took Nissan and made it into the second largest car company behind
sentences.zh: 在他的领导下，他将日产打造成了仅次于

sentences.en: Toyota.
sentences.zh: 丰田的第二大汽车公司。

sentences.en: So he leapfrogged over Honda and made it number two in Japan.
sentences.zh: 所以他超越了本田，成为日本的第二大企业。

sentences.en: But please don't let all these attractive qualities go to your head or to your lead foot.
sentences.zh: 但请不要让所有这些吸引人的特质冲昏了你的头脑或踩重了你的油门。

sentences.en: He also got them to 100 million of sales in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他还让他们在美国的销售额达到了1亿。

sentences.en: He, I think it was quadrupled the stock market value of the company within a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 我想，他在短短几年内使公司的市值翻了四倍。

sentences.en: So he really delivered on his promise.
sentences.zh: 所以他真的兑现了他的承诺。

sentences.en: When over 300,000 people buy the same car, it's more than a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 当超过30万人买同一辆车时，这就不仅仅是巧合了。

sentences.en: It's a success.
sentences.zh: 这是一个成功。

sentences.en: So it kind of appears like he's performed a miracle in saving this auto company that no one thought that anyone could save.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来他创造了一个奇迹，拯救了这家没有人认为有人能拯救的汽车公司。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: He was promoted to CEO by 2001.
sentences.zh: 他在2001年被晋升为首席执行官。

sentences.en: And then his reputation started to kind of take off.
sentences.zh: 然后他的声誉开始飙升。

sentences.en: Superstar CEO, also a larger than life figure and almost an icon for many Japanese.
sentences.zh: 超级巨星首席执行官，也是一个超凡脱俗的人物，对许多日本人来说几乎是一个偶像。

sentences.en: He's kind of like the Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, Lea Iacocca all rolled into one for Japan, a place that they're not really all that used to having superstar corporate executives.
sentences.zh: 对于日本这个并不太习惯有超级明星企业高管的地方来说，他有点像是史蒂夫·乔布斯、埃隆·马斯克、李·艾柯卡的结合体。

sentences.en: He appeared everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他无处不在。

sentences.en: He was on TV a lot.
sentences.zh: 他经常上电视。

sentences.en: When he was at auto industry shows, he would stand and sign autographs.
sentences.zh: 当他在车展上时，他会站着签名。

sentences.en: People really liked him.
sentences.zh: 人们真的很喜欢他。

sentences.en: And there was even a manga comic book that was made about his life.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一本关于他生平的漫画书。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: There was a whole illustrated comic book about his life, which all these Japanese businessmen are reading on the trains.
sentences.zh: 有一整本关于他生平的插图漫画书，所有的日本商人都在火车上阅读它。

sentences.en: He writes a memoir about this turnaround, and that's a bestseller.
sentences.zh: 他写了一本关于这次公司转型的回忆录，并且成了畅销书。

sentences.en: The emperor gives him a medal, which he becomes the first foreign business executive to win it.
sentences.zh: 天皇授予他一枚勋章，他成为了赢得该奖项的第一位外国企业高管。

sentences.en: So he's definitely a big superstar.
sentences.zh: 所以他绝对是一个大超级巨星。

sentences.en: And then Nissan has bought properties for him to use in Rio de
sentences.zh: 然后日产为他购买了供他在巴西里约

sentences.en: Janeiro, in Brazil, in Paris, France, in Beirut, Lebanon, in Amsterdam, in Holland.
sentences.zh: 热内卢、法国巴黎、黎巴嫩贝鲁特、荷兰阿姆斯特丹使用的房产。

sentences.en: So now all of a sudden he has all these properties, including a very nice apartment in Tokyo, and he's living this very lavish lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 所以现在突然之间他拥有了所有这些房产，包括在东京的一套非常漂亮的公寓，他过着非常奢华的生活方式。

sentences.en: And he even takes a second wife, and they get married at Versailles in France, and a Marie Antoinette-themed wedding.
sentences.zh: 他甚至娶了第二任妻子，他们在法国凡尔赛宫结婚，举办了一场玛丽·安托瓦内特主题的婚礼。

sentences.en: And we start to see a little bit of signs of maybe how he's crossing a line in Japan where there's a high value put on humility, a modesty, being a little bit
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到一些迹象，表明他可能在日本越界了，因为日本非常重视谦逊、低调、有点

sentences.en: quiet, not necessarily bragging about yourself.
sentences.zh: 安静，不一定四处自吹自擂。

sentences.en: And I think from his perspective, he just felt,
sentences.zh: 我想从他的角度来看，他只是觉得，

sentences.en: I'm just doing what a corporate CEO of a global company should be doing.
sentences.zh: 我只是在做一个全球公司的企业CEO该做的事情。

sentences.en: He had rescued the company.
sentences.zh: 他拯救了公司。

sentences.en: That's incontrovertible.
sentences.zh: 这是无可争辩的。

sentences.en: And he had proven that his methods, though painful, worked for shareholders and for the company.
sentences.zh: 他已经证明了他的方法，尽管痛苦，但对股东和公司都是有效的。

sentences.en: Management is not about doing easy things.
sentences.zh: 管理不是为了做轻松的事。

sentences.en: Management is about doing things that usually people don't want to do.
sentences.zh: 管理是为了做通常人们不想做的事。

sentences.en: And I guess even if he's rubbing people the wrong way culturally, shareholders are happy with him.
sentences.zh: 我想，即使他在文化上让人感到不快，股东们对他也感到满意。

sentences.en: The media treats him like a darling.
sentences.zh: 媒体把他当成宠儿。

sentences.en: And it's working out perfectly well for him, given these houses that are being rented for him, this lavish wedding.
sentences.zh: 鉴于为他租的这些房子和这场奢华的婚礼，这对他的发展来说完美无缺。

sentences.en: This is working well.
sentences.zh: 这很顺利。

sentences.en: You would think so, but it turns out that he was still quite unhappy.
sentences.zh: 你可能会这么认为，但事实证明他仍然很不快乐。

sentences.en: I think he felt that compared to his peers in the international auto industry, he was not paid well.
sentences.zh: 我想他觉得与国际汽车行业的同行相比，他的薪酬不高。

sentences.en: And so even though he was making, say, $16.9 million, that was much less than the $21 million and change of, say, Mary Barra at General
sentences.zh: 所以即使他赚了，比方说，1690万美元，这也比通用汽车的玛丽

sentences.en: Motors.
sentences.zh: 巴拉等人2100多万美元要少得多。

sentences.en: And so I think that he felt that he was not compensated appropriately for the level at which he was playing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他觉得他的薪酬与他的地位不相称。

sentences.en: People look at this by saying, yeah, but in Japan, you're the highest seller in Japan.
sentences.zh: 人们看到这一点会说，是的，但在日本，你是日本收入最高的人。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So at the same time, Nissan, it cannot be considered only as a Japanese company.
sentences.zh: 因此，与此同时，日产不能仅仅被视为一家日本公司。

sentences.en: It is a company based in Japan, but on a global trend.
sentences.zh: 它是一家立足日本但具有全球化趋势的公司。

sentences.en: So why is he making less money than his American counterparts?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么他的收入比美国同行少呢？

sentences.en: What explains that?
sentences.zh: 这怎么解释？

sentences.en: So I think there are a couple of things going on here.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这里有几件事正在发生。

sentences.en: First of all, in Japan, in general, there's this more this egalitarian sense that it's somehow unseemly for the top
sentences.zh: 首先，在日本，总的来说，有一种更偏向平等的观念，认为高管的薪酬

sentences.en: executive in a company to make too many multiples of what the average salary person makes in the company.
sentences.zh: 是公司普通员工平均工资的好几倍，这在某种程度上是不合体统的。

sentences.en: In the case of Nissan, they actually tried to sort of institute that in their own codes and they put a cap on the amount of pay that all executives could make.
sentences.zh: 就日产而言，他们实际上试图在自己的规章制度中建立这一点，并对所有高管的薪酬设定了上限。

sentences.en: So this was in 2008.
sentences.zh: 所以这是在2008年。

sentences.en: Japanese law actually began to require that companies disclose directors' pay in their annual report.
sentences.zh: 日本法律实际上开始要求公司在年度报告中披露董事薪酬。

sentences.en: And so that year, Nissan shareholders voted to set an annual cap of about $27 million on compensation.
sentences.zh: 因此在那一年，日产股东投票决定将薪酬年度上限设定在约2700万美元。

sentences.en: And that was for all board directors combined.
sentences.zh: 这是所有董事会成员的总和。

sentences.en: So that was part of what was driving it, was that they knew that they would have to tell the public what they were paying everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是推动这一情况的部分原因，因为他们知道他们必须告诉公众他们付给每个人的薪水。

sentences.en: So if Carlos
sentences.zh: 所以如果卡洛斯

sentences.en: Ghosn wanted to make sure that he got top pay, that meant there would be very little left for all the other directors on the board.
sentences.zh: 戈恩想要确保自己拿到最高薪水，那就意味着留给董事会其他所有董事的所剩无几。

sentences.en: So the bigger his salary, the smaller the salary of those around him, his deputies who work with him.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的薪水越高，他周围那些与他共事的副手们的薪水就越少。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, Nissan itself is not doing so well.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，日产本身的情况并不那么好。

sentences.en: And it started to become clear that they were not meeting their targets.
sentences.zh: 而且人们渐渐清楚地看到，他们没有达到目标。

sentences.en: And dealers were starting to complain.
sentences.zh: 经销商也开始抱怨。

sentences.en: They were saying they were being forced to sell cars at deep discounts.
sentences.zh: 他们说自己被迫以极大的折扣出售汽车。

sentences.en: So there was a lot of general dissatisfaction.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有很多普遍的不满情绪。

sentences.en: So there started to be some whispers.
sentences.zh: 因此开始有一些窃窃私语。

sentences.en: It was the Ghosn magic disappearing.
sentences.zh: 那是戈恩的魔法在消失。

sentences.en: And then in November 2018, Carlos Ghosn lands in a corporate jet at Haneda Airport in Tokyo.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2018年11月，卡洛斯·戈恩乘坐一架公务机在东京羽田机场降落。

sentences.en: And there are cameras waiting at the airport and prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 机场里有等待着的摄像机和检察官。

sentences.en: And these prosecutors board the plane and they start to question him.
sentences.zh: 这些检察官登上了飞机并开始盘问他。

sentences.en: And then they take him in and they arrest him.
sentences.zh: 然后他们把他带走并逮捕了他。

sentences.en: Breaking news.
sentences.zh: 突发新闻。

sentences.en: In the past few minutes, Nissan has revealed that its chairman has been arrested.
sentences.zh: 就在过去几分钟里，日产披露其董事长已被逮捕。

sentences.en: And it's this sort of crazy scenario that the CEO, who was revered as a rock star in the auto industry,
sentences.zh: 这就是这种疯狂的剧本：这位在汽车行业被尊为摇滚巨星的CEO，

sentences.en: that was well known on the Davos circuit, was suddenly arrested in Tokyo and taken to jail, was a total shock.
sentences.zh: 在达沃斯论坛上广为人知，却突然在东京被捕并被送进监狱，这真是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: Question is now, of course, will the board oust him, which, of course, we largely expect, not just from Nissan, but from the other car companies that Carlos Ghosn heads up.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在的问题是，董事会会罢免他吗？这当然是我们大体上所预料到的，不仅来自日产，也来自卡洛斯·戈恩领导的其他汽车公司。

sentences.en: And what has he been arrested for?
sentences.zh: 他因为什么被捕？

sentences.en: What are the accusations?
sentences.zh: 指控是什么？

sentences.en: It was an internal investigation that was launched and took place in the last few months that led us to this moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一项在过去几个月里启动并进行的内部调查，将我们带到了这一刻。

sentences.en: So the allegations have to do with pay.
sentences.zh: 所以这些指控与薪酬有关。

sentences.en: It turns out, according to the prosecutors, that Carlos Ghosn, in cooperation with a top aide named Greg Kelly, that they had basically figured out a way to pay
sentences.zh: 据检察官称，事实证明，卡洛斯·戈恩与一名名为格雷格·凯利的顶级助手合作，他们基本上想出了一种方法，来支付

sentences.en: Carlos Ghosn more than they were declaring on their annual reports.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩比他们在年度报告中申报的更多的薪水。

sentences.en: Nissan says it's been going on for years.
sentences.zh: 日产表示这种情况已经持续多年了。

sentences.en: So the allegation is that he hid about half his pay.
sentences.zh: 所以指控称他隐瞒了大约一半的薪水。

sentences.en: And the way, apparently, he did that is that they effectively created sort of two pots of pay.
sentences.zh: 显然，他这样做的办法是他们实际上创建了两种薪酬池。

sentences.en: So there was the legal, above-board, within-limit pay that he was given every year.
sentences.zh: 一种是他每年获得的合法的、明面上的、限额之内的薪水。

sentences.en: And then there were sort of these IOUs of the amount of pay that he would get after he left Nissan.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一些类似于他离开日产后将获得的薪酬数额的欠条。

sentences.en: And so the allegation is that he figured out a way to pay himself basically double what they were reporting to the securities agencies.
sentences.zh: 所以指控称，他想出了一种方法，让自己的实际收入基本上翻倍，达到他们向证券机构报告的两倍。

sentences.en: And so the indictment is that they failed to report his full pay.
sentences.zh: 因此起诉书指出他们未能报告他的全部薪酬。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And how big a deal is this charge?
sentences.zh: 这个指控有多严重？

sentences.en: So this charge, I think, there's been a lot of debate.
sentences.zh: 所以对于这个指控，我认为有很多争论。

sentences.en: When he was first arrested, I think a lot of people said, why are they arresting him for this?
sentences.zh: 当他刚被捕时，我想很多人都在说，他们为什么要为此逮捕他？

sentences.en: I mean, come on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，拜托。

sentences.en: First of all, it's the company's responsibility.
sentences.zh: 首先，这是公司的责任。

sentences.en: Do you actually think that Carlos Ghosn sits in an office and fills out the securities filings?
sentences.zh: 你真的认为卡洛斯·戈恩坐在办公室里填写证券申报文件吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: And then the other bigger point I think people were making was, if there's a debate about whether he's being paid too much
sentences.zh: 然后我认为人们提出的另一个更重要的问题是，如果有争论说他是否拿到太多薪水

sentences.en: or he's breaking the internal shareholder rule about the cap, isn't that something that should be dealt with by the board of directors,
sentences.zh: 或者他是否打破了关于上限的内部股东规则，这难道不应该是由董事会处理的事情，

sentences.en: not something that should be brought to prosecutors?
sentences.zh: 而不是应该交给检察官的事情吗？

sentences.en: Does the guy need to be thrown in jail for this issue?
sentences.zh: 这这家伙需要因为这个问题而被扔进监狱吗？

sentences.en: So there's a lot of debate about that.
sentences.zh: 所以对此有很多争论。

sentences.en: I think a lot of it is cultural.
sentences.zh: 我认为很大程度上是文化问题。

sentences.en: So when you talk to people in the expat community, you hear a lot of that sort of questioning of whether this was an appropriate use of prosecutorial power.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你与外籍人士社区的人交谈时，你会听到很多这种质疑，即这是否是对检察权力的恰当使用。

sentences.en: Whereas if you talk to Japanese business people, a lot of them say, look, the law is that you have to report your pay.
sentences.zh: 而如果你与日本商界人士交谈，他们中的很多人会说，听着，法律规定你必须申报你的薪酬。

sentences.en: And they didn't report his pay.
sentences.zh: 而他们没有申报他的薪酬。

sentences.en: And he was the chief executive and chairman of the company.
sentences.zh: 他是公司的首席执行官兼董事长。

sentences.en: And so he should have known that they were misreporting his pay.
sentences.zh: 所以他本应该知道他们漏报了他的薪酬。

sentences.en: So there are all these reactions out there.
sentences.zh: 所以有所有这些不同的反应。

sentences.en: And then Ghosn himself, as we've seen in this video.
sentences.zh: 然后就像我们在视频中看到的那样，戈恩本人...

sentences.en: I've been always consistent with this position that I was innocent of all the charges.
sentences.zh: 我一直坚持这种立场，即我对其所有指控都是清白的。

sentences.en: First and foremost, he says he's innocent.
sentences.zh: 首先也是最重要的是，他说他是无辜的。

sentences.en: And he kind of leaves that out there.
sentences.zh: 他姑且把话放在那里。

sentences.en: The second message I want to send you is the fact that...
sentences.zh: 我要向你们传达的第二个信息是...

sentences.en: And then he goes on to talk about how he wants to emphasize that he loves Japan.
sentences.zh: 接着他继续谈到他想强调他热爱日本。

sentences.en: I love Japan.
sentences.zh: 我热爱日本。

sentences.en: And I love Nissan.
sentences.zh: 我也热爱日产。

sentences.en: Nobody spends 20 years in a country without love and without attachment.
sentences.zh: 没有人会在一个国家度过20年而没有爱和眷恋。

sentences.en: But then he talks about how he has been the victim of a campaign of backstabbing.
sentences.zh: 但随后他谈到了自己如何成为背后捅刀子运动的受害者。

sentences.en: This is a conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 这是一个阴谋。

sentences.en: And he won't name names, but he's talking about these people who he says are now in charge of Nissan.
sentences.zh: 他不会点名，但他指的是那些他所说现在掌管日产的人。

sentences.en: And he's really worried about Nissan.
sentences.zh: 他真的很为日产担心。

sentences.en: I'm talking here about a few executives who, obviously, for their own interests and for their own selfish fears, are creating a lot of value destruction.
sentences.zh: 我这里指的是一些高管，他们显然为了自身利益和自私的恐惧，正在造成大量的价值毁灭。

sentences.en: Because these executives who he won't name, who he says have been backstabbing and betraying him,
sentences.zh: 因为这些他不会点名的高管，他称他们一直在背后捅刀子和背叛他，

sentences.en: have done that because they are so threatened by the fact that Nissan is getting closer to Renault.
sentences.zh: 他们之所以这样做，是因为日产越来越接近雷诺，这让他们感到了巨大的威胁。

sentences.en: There was first a fear that the next step of the alliance in terms of convergence and in terms of moving toward the merger would, in a certain way,
sentences.zh: 首先有一种担忧，即联盟在融合以及迈向合并方面的下一步，在某种程度上会

sentences.en: threaten some people or eventually threaten the autonomy of Nissan.
sentences.zh: 威胁到某些人，或者最终威胁到日产的自主权。

sentences.en: So this big household name in Japan is worried about kind of being swallowed up by a French company.
sentences.zh: 所以这个在日本家喻户晓的名字担心会被一家法国公司吞并。

sentences.en: Which, by the way, has never been threatened for the last 19 years.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，在过去的19年里，这种威胁从未存在过。

sentences.en: And Carlos Ghosn is telling us that the executives at the Japanese company have been so worried about this that they are trying to kick him out.
sentences.zh: 卡洛斯·戈恩告诉我们，这家日本公司的高管对此感到非常担忧，以至于他们正试图把他赶走。

sentences.en: That's where the fear came.
sentences.zh: 恐惧就是从那里来的。

sentences.en: Because the performance of Nissan is not good.
sentences.zh: 因为日产的业绩不好。

sentences.en: It has degradated a lot.
sentences.zh: 它已经退化了很多。

sentences.en: But he's being a little bit vague and it's kind of cloak and dagger.
sentences.zh: 但他有点含糊其辞，这有点像谍战剧。

sentences.en: And we're not quite sure what's happening.
sentences.zh: 我们不太确定发生了什么。

sentences.en: I am privileged to have three competent lawyers around me who's going to defend the case.
sentences.zh: 我很荣幸能有三位能干的律师在我身边为这个案件辩护。

sentences.en: And then he goes on to say...
sentences.zh: 然后他继续说...

sentences.en: But they don't share with me a lot of serenity about the fairness of the trial.
sentences.zh: 但他们并没有让我对审判的公正性感到多少安心。

sentences.en: All I hope is that I will get a fair trial.
sentences.zh: 我唯一的希望就是能得到一个公正的审判。

sentences.en: That I can be hopefully vindicated.
sentences.zh: 希望我能被证明是清白的。

sentences.en: And why would he not get a fair trial?
sentences.zh: 他为什么会得不到公正的审判？

sentences.en: Well, the Japanese criminal justice system, we've learned a lot through this case, is not what you would necessarily expect from a modern democracy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，通过这个案子我们学到了很多，日本的刑事司法系统并不一定是你对一个现代民主国家所期望的那样。

sentences.en: So, prosecutors are allowed to keep any defendant for up to 48 hours without indicting them at all.
sentences.zh: 因此，检察官被允许在不指控任何人的情况下，将任何嫌疑人拘留长达48小时。

sentences.en: And while they're questioning them, the defendant is not allowed to have his own lawyer present.
sentences.zh: 在审问他们时，被告不允许有自己的律师在场。

sentences.en: Now, in the U.S., of course, if you don't charge someone within 48 hours, they're out.
sentences.zh: 在美国，当然，如果你在48小时内不指控某人，他们就会被释放。

sentences.en: But in this case, after the 48 hours, the prosecutors have the right to go to the court and say, you know, we're not quite done questioning.
sentences.zh: 但在这种情况下，48小时后，检察官有权向法院说，你知道，我们还没有审问完。

sentences.en: Can we keep them for another 10 days?
sentences.zh: 我们可以再关押他们10天吗？

sentences.en: And after the 10 days, the prosecutors reapply to the court and say, you know what?
sentences.zh: 而在10天后，检察官再次向法院申请并说道，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We actually need 10 more days.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上还需要10天。

sentences.en: And they gave it to him.
sentences.zh: 他们就批准了。

sentences.en: So, he was held originally for 22 days without being charged at all, without being allowed to have his lawyer present while he's being questioned.
sentences.zh: 所以，他最初在未受任何指控、且审讯时不允许律师在场的情况下，被关押了22天。

sentences.en: So, when you look at all of that, criminal justice experts in the United States are saying, this is not how you would expect a democratic country with, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，当你看到这一切时，美国的刑事司法专家们会说，这可不是你期望一个拥有，你知道的，

sentences.en: basic civil rights to run their criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 基本公民权利的民主国家运营其刑事司法系统的方式。

sentences.en: So, Motoko, is any of this typical for how Japan would treat an executive in similar circumstances, facing similar allegations?
sentences.zh: 那么，莫子子，这一切对于日本如何对待在类似情况下、面临类似指控的高管来说是否典型？

sentences.en: So, that's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: I mean, it's certainly when you talk to expats, they sort of say, aha, this is definitely a case of mistreating the foreigner.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你和外籍人士交谈时，他们确实会说，啊哈，这绝对是一个虐待外国人的案例。

sentences.en: And I did talk to someone who said, look, you know, in Japan, we will tolerate fraud conducted on behalf of the companies.
sentences.zh: 我确实和某个人交谈过，他说，听着，你知道，在日本，我们会容忍代表公司进行的欺诈行为。

sentences.en: But what Japan will not tolerate is personal greed.
sentences.zh: 但日本不会容忍的是个人贪婪。

sentences.en: And so, that is sort of the sense in which Carlos Ghosn has been cast, that what he is accused of having done was all for himself personally.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就是对卡洛斯·戈恩的一种看法，即他被指控所做的一切完全是为了他个人。

sentences.en: So, crime may be okay if it's done on behalf of a corporation and its employees, but crime done on behalf of oneself, pure greed, that crosses the line.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果犯罪是代表公司及其员工进行的，那可能还可以接受，但如果是为了自己而犯罪、纯粹的贪婪，那就越界了。

sentences.en: That may help explain why Carlos Ghosn was being treated this way.
sentences.zh: 这或许有助于解释为什么卡洛斯·戈恩会受到这样的对待。

sentences.en: I think in part.
sentences.zh: 我认为部分是这样。

sentences.en: That's certainly what a lot of people have told me.
sentences.zh: 这确实是很多人对我说过的。

sentences.en: But then, after he'd been out on bail for a month, he's rearrested.
sentences.zh: 但随后，在他获得保释一个月后，他又被重新逮捕了。

sentences.en: Early Thursday morning, Japanese prosecutors paid a visit to Carlos Ghosn's apartment.
sentences.zh: 周四清晨，日本检察官造访了卡洛斯·戈恩的公寓。

sentences.en: Blocking the entrance from prying eyes, they arrested the former auto titan.
sentences.zh: 为了挡住窥探的目光，他们封锁了入口，逮捕了这位前汽车巨头。

sentences.en: And that's kind of why we were seeing that video, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们为什么会看到那个视频的原因，对吧？

sentences.en: That he couldn't appear at the press conference that he was promising to give.
sentences.zh: 他无法出席他承诺要召开的新闻发布会。

sentences.en: He's now back in jail.
sentences.zh: 他现在又回到了监狱里。

sentences.en: And these charges seem a little more serious.
sentences.zh: 这些指控看起来更严重了一些。

sentences.en: This time, Ghosn's been arrested after suspicions by Nissan that some payments to its Oman dealership were for personal use by its former chairman.
sentences.zh: 这一次，戈恩被捕是因为日产怀疑其阿曼经销商的一些付款被这位前董事长用于个人消费。

sentences.en: To the tune of nearly 4 million euros, according to Japanese media.
sentences.zh: 据日本媒体报道，金额接近400万欧元。

sentences.en: And that, if there's any evidence, sounds more like a charge of embezzlement.
sentences.zh: 如果存在任何证据，听起来这更像是挪用公款的指控。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So, if true, these are far more serious allegations than setting up a long-term deferred compensation fund, as he was originally accused.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果属实，这些指控比他最初被指控设立长期延期薪酬基金要严重得多。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I talked to this lawyer, an American, who's been in Japan for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位在美国在日本待了很长时间的律师。

sentences.en: And he was one of the people who was defending Carlos Ghosn at the beginning and saying,
sentences.zh: 他是一开始为卡洛斯·戈恩辩护并说的人之一：

sentences.en: Come on, these are trumped-up charges.
sentences.zh: 拜托，这些都是捏造的指控。

sentences.en: You should just deal with this internally.
sentences.zh: 你们应该在内部处理这件事。

sentences.en: And now he's saying, it looks like the prosecutors went on a fishing expedition.
sentences.zh: 而现在他说，看起来检察官是在进行漫无目的的钓鱼执法。

sentences.en: At the beginning, all they had were a couple of minnows.
sentences.zh: 一开始，他们手里只有几条小鱼。

sentences.en: But now they've got the big fish.
sentences.zh: 但现在他们钓到大鱼了。

sentences.en: I'm struck that Carlos Ghosn is celebrated for so long for having broken the mold, because that's what creates this big success inside Nissan.
sentences.zh: 让我震撼的是，卡洛斯·戈恩长期以来因打破常规而受到赞誉，因为正是这一点在日产内部创造了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: And people seem to embrace all that mold breaking, but then say to him, you need to fit the rest of the mold culturally, especially around money.
sentences.zh: 人们似乎欣然接受了所有这些打破常规的做法，但随后又对他说，你在文化上需要符合其余的常规，尤其是在金钱方面。

sentences.en: And that happens to coincide with the company that had been such a success starting to tank.
sentences.zh: 而这恰好与一家曾取得巨大成功的公司开始走下坡路的时间相吻合。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think in a lot of ways, and perhaps this is not unique to Japan, that you can get away with whatever you want as long as you're successful.
sentences.zh: 我认为在许多方面，也许这并非日本所独有，只要你成功，你就可以为所欲为。

sentences.en: And once you're not so successful anymore, then all that rule-breaking and brashness doesn't look so attractive and appealing anymore.
sentences.zh: 而一旦你不再那么成功，那么所有打破规则和鲁莽的行为看起来就不那么有吸引力和迷人了。

sentences.en: So I think that may have been partly what happened to Carlos Ghosn.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这可能正是卡洛斯·戈恩身上发生的部分原因。

sentences.en: I think there's another thing operating here, which is that he really fundamentally represents a different way of looking at leadership.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里还有另一件事在起作用，那就是他从根本上代表了一种看待领导力的新方式。

sentences.en: Japanese corporate culture is very consensual.
sentences.zh: 日本的企业文化是非常注重协商一致的。

sentences.en: And he even references this in his video.
sentences.zh: 他甚至在视频中提到了这一点。

sentences.en: He sort of says something along the lines of, what you call dictatorial is just good leadership.
sentences.zh: 他大概是说，你们所谓的独裁其实就是好的领导力。

sentences.en: And what we need to do is what's good for the company, not just something we can agree upon.
sentences.zh: 而我们需要做的是对公司有益的事，而不只是大家都能妥协同意的事。

sentences.en: And that's really like taking a big, you know, water gun and pointing it right at the center of what is one of the most valued ways of doing business in Japan,
sentences.zh: 这真的就像是拿着一把大水枪，你知道的，直指日本商业中最宝贵的方式的核心，

sentences.en: which is that everything is decided by consensus.
sentences.zh: 也就是一切都通过协商一致来决定。

sentences.en: Or at least you give the appearance of everything being decided by consensus.
sentences.zh: 或者至少你要营造出一切都通过协商一致来决定的表象。

sentences.en: And he did not pay attention to that.
sentences.zh: 而他根本没有理会这一点。

sentences.en: And so I think that's a lot of where the cultural clash is coming from.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这就是文化冲突很大一部分的来源。

sentences.en: And he's really being defined about it.
sentences.zh: 而且他对此真的非常固执。

sentences.en: Like he's going to go down kicking and screaming and he's not going to give up on wanting to say, I was a very good, I am a very good leader and you don't recognize it.
sentences.zh: 就像他会进行垂死挣扎，绝不放弃想要表达的意思：我曾经是一个非常优秀、我现在也是一个非常优秀的领导者，而你们却没有意识到。

sentences.en: And you're calling me a dictator.
sentences.zh: 你们却在叫我独裁者。

sentences.en: But all I am is trying to show visionary leadership.
sentences.zh: 但我所做的一切都只是在展现富有远见的领导力。

sentences.en: Can we see this, Motoko, as Nissan kind of prioritizing the preservation of Japanese culture over saving the company itself?
sentences.zh: 我们可以这样看吗，元子，日产似乎把保护日本文化看得比拯救公司本身更重要？

sentences.en: I think that there's part of it that is about Japanese culture wins out above all, that if you're going to be in Japan, you need to learn to adhere to Japanese culture.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一部分原因确实是日本文化高于一切，如果你要在日本，你就需要学会遵守日本文化。

sentences.en: I think there is a part of it there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得确实有这方面的原因。

sentences.en: I also think that in this particular case,
sentences.zh: 我也觉得在特定情况下，

sentences.en: he probably would have continued to get away with it if that's the way of putting it or been allowed to behave as he does if the company was continuing to be successful.
sentences.zh: 如果换作平时，或者如果公司继续保持成功的话，他可能还会继续为所欲为，或者被允许保持他那种行为方式。

sentences.en: But it was starting to slow down.
sentences.zh: 但公司开始走下坡路了。

sentences.en: There were signs that the magic had gone.
sentences.zh: 有迹象表明那种魔力已经消失了。

sentences.en: And so then the mold breaker is no longer looked at as a success story, but more as someone who needs to be brushed aside.
sentences.zh: 于是，这个打破常规的人不再被视为成功的故事，而是被看作一个需要被清除出局的人。

sentences.en: And let's go back to the old ways.
sentences.zh: 让我们回到老路上去吧。

sentences.en: We know how to do things here.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里知道该怎么做事。

sentences.en: Motoko, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 元子，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在该App里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》的订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是《纽约时报》的订阅者，今天就下载《时报》App，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: A massive fire at the Cathedral of Notre Dame, an 800-year-old monument to Catholicism and architecture in the center of Paris,
sentences.zh: 巴黎市中心的巴黎圣母院发生了一场大火，这座拥有800年历史的天主教和建筑纪念碑，

sentences.en: has destroyed most of the building's roof, central spire, and interior.
sentences.zh: 已烧毁了该建筑的大部分屋顶、中央尖顶和内部。

sentences.en: The fire began around 6.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 大火始于当地时间下午6点半左右，

sentences.en: local time in an area of the cathedral covered in scaffolding and quickly spread across its wooden roof, which dates back to medieval times.
sentences.zh: 地点在教堂一个搭满脚手架的区域，并迅速蔓延到其可追溯至中世纪的木制屋顶。

sentences.en: The cause of the fire is unknown, but authorities said it was likely connected to a major renovation project.
sentences.zh: 起火原因尚不清楚，但官方表示可能与一项重大修缮工程有关。

sentences.en: Thousands of Parisians watched the fire in horror, with one witness telling The Times through tears, We lose this.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的巴黎市民惊恐地看着这场大火，一位目击者含泪告诉《时报》：我们失去了这个。

sentences.en: We lose Paris.
sentences.zh: 我们失去了巴黎。

sentences.en: It is apocalyptic.
sentences.zh: 这简直是世界末日般的景象。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运转。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党便陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权力斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都会》节目中，由我萨拉·凯尼格为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却最终失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都会》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
